tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las btswa' bsrung rdo rje pha lam gyi gsal byed rdo rje'i ngar bskyed pa pha lam rab gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki niā ye/ /byams mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /dbyer med padma kā ra la/ /gus btud snyigs 'gro skyabs pa'i phyir/ /dgongs 'dus btswa' bsrung gsal byed 'dri/ /de la rang bzhin gyi btswa' dang / sde brgyad kyi btswa' gnyis las/ rang bzhin btswa' la skam rlon gnyis kyi/ skam btswa' ni than pas bskyed pa'i dmar skya zhig sog ma'i sked man chad kyi tshigs bar du 'byung ba de ni char babs pa dang sangs 'gro/ ma sangs na chu nan ched bya/ rang bzhin rlon btswa' ni char zhod ches pa'am 'og rlon skyon gyi mdog dang yong sa gong mtshungs 'byung yang nyi ma tsha mo zhag sbrel nas byung bas sangs 'gro/ gal te rang bzhin gyi skam rlon gyi btswa' de gnyis kyang char chu dang nyi mas 'phral du sangs mi thub pa byung na/ rim 'gror chab klu btang / rngan gtor zhing yur zhes pa sles sogs btswa' yan rnams 'don pa dang chabs cig btswa' dmar skya yod pa rnams kyang 'thog shing sna'i dud pa zhes ri klung la skyes pa'i shing sna gang 'dzoms las lci sbangs la sogs srog chags las byung ba'i me shing ming btags rnams mi gtong / gang ltar yang thabs des mi phan pa mi srid do/ /gnyis pa sde brgyad kyi btswa' la'ang skam rlon khra gsum las/ dang po than pas bskyed pa'i skam btswa' la ser dmar gnyis kyi/ ser po rgyal po'i btswa' ni snye thon dang / snye kha 'grig nas ser skya dri ngan bro ba zhig gi snye stong 'byung bas/ rgyal gsol rgyal mdos sogs bya/ dmar po btsan dang ma mo'i btswa' ni/ ljang pa thon 'phral smug nag rtser chags shing / sdong bu'i tshigs la'ang chu sbur lta bu dang lo mar dmar thig 'char bas zhing la khrag ris kyi skam nas sog ma'ang mi 'byung bas/ btsan gsol/

btsan mdos/ ma gsol ma mdos sogs bya/ gnyis pa rlon btswa' klu gnyen bdud kyi btswa' ni char chu ches pas byed cing / lo shin tu legs pa 'dra ba zhig la rtsa bar dmar nag khrag rdul lta bu chags nas rim gyis thams cad za bas sa bdag klu gnyen mnyes pa'i cho ga dang / bdud kyi mdos sogs bya/ 'di dag ni lung pa gcig tu'ang zhing 'ga' rer 'byung ba las spyi khyab tu mi 'byung / btswa' khra bo zhes pa ser skya/ dmar skya/ dmar nag khra thig la sogs pa 'byung ba de ni sde brgyad kyi btswa' ste lung pa gcig tu zhing yongs rdzogs la 'byung zhing / ljang pa dang sdong bu dang / snye ma thon pa sogs gnas skabs thams cad la khyab nas shin tu gnod tshab che bas rgya brngan/ chab klu/ brgya bzhi'i glud sogs rim 'gro rgya cher bya dgos par gsungs so/ /de ltar skam rlon khra gsum las/ dang po skam btswa' bsrung ba ni/ khye'u grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa dbang po la skyon ma zhugs pas nyin gsum bzhi sogs kyis bar du sha chang sgog tsong tha ma kha sogs spang te/ nang re bzhin la kha lag bkru/ a ka ru dang mkhan pa/ spang spos sogs spos gtsang ma gang rung gi lus bdugs/ chu khams kyi gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms nyin bzang / khro lcags snod ma yin pa gser dngul li rdza shing snod sogs gtsang mar/ chu mig kha shar bltas kyi chu gtsang sbras blangs la/ de la chu sna gtsang ma mang po dang / ra dkar ba dmar gnyis kyi 'o ma/ klu sman/ dug rigs ma yin pa'i 'bru sna'i phye ma btab pa'i rlon thun bshams la/ bsrung chog byed pa po gsar rnying gang rung bla med kyi lugs kyi dbang thob cing gu ru zhi drag gam kyai rdor sogs kyi bsnyen pa las su rung ba zhig gis sde dkar byas la bzlas bsgom gyi rim pa ni/ na mo thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang / /mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus la/ /bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams/

/byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /zhes nyer gcig sogs/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bsgrub nas kyang / /gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ /'gro don byed pa sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /lan gcig dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la snying rje shar/ /zung 'jug ngo bo gzugs kyi sku/ /rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum/ /spyan gnyis dbu skra thor tshugs can/ /sku la shel dkar gos zung bsnams/ /sna chogs rin chen rgyan gyi spras/ /phyag g.yas shel dkar phreng ba dang / /g.yon pas shel bum bdud rtsi can/ /mnyam bzhengs 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba yis/ /thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig la/ /rtsa gsum sngags kyi tha ma ru/ /gang bsrung bsham bu'i bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros 'gro la gnod byed dang / /ser dmar rgyal btsan ma mo'i btswa'/ /skam btswa'i gnod pa ci mchis kun/ /skad cig nyid la 'joms nus par/ /rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /zhes dang shel dkar sogs kyi phreng ba bzung la/ rtsa gsum gyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa 'di yin/ bsham bu ni/ oṃ na ga buṃ pa shig dza ti chuṃ bra ba rtsad nas drongs/ nā ga rā dza kha thaṃ/ zhes sbrel la/ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs ci 'grub bzlas pa'i phu mchil ma ma 'chor bar chu la btab thun mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khyed sku sogs/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs/ bsngo smon shes brjod ci shes byas nas/ gang la bya ba'i zhing khar song la/

mi byi phag lo pa gos lh+wam skya bo gyon zhing rdor dkar la gnas pa kha shas mdun du bos la/ skyabs sems gong sngon 'gro'i de rnams gong bzhin spyan ras gzigs dbang du bskyed pa ni/ gzhan 'dra ba las/ 'di rnams spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar/ /zhes pa nas/ rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ de rnams kyi gong gi rlon thun sngags chu rdza snod sogs su g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pas rnga yab dkar po sogs kyi 'thor yab thogs la/ zhing gi dkyil nas phyir babs bzhin gtor la/ gong gi sngags 'don shes na skad chen pos bzlar gzhug mi shes na rang nyid kyang de dag dang lhan du song la sngags skad chen pos bzla zhing / spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yon gyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa las chu rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa babs pas btswa' dmar skam brtswa'i rigs thams cad bkrus nas zhing rdo rje'i sa gzhi lo thog thams cad rdo rjes 'greng bur gyur ba'i phyi nas rdo rje'i rwa drwa gur bla bres bstum pas skam btsa'i gnod pa skad cig kyang mi 'byung bar bsam la gong bzhin bsngo smon shes brjod bya ba ni skam btswa' bkru ba ste/ de lta bu lan gnyis gsum sogs gang dgos bya'o/ /gnyis pa rlon btswa' bsrung ba ni gong gi khye'u me rlung sa khams gza' skar bzang po la/ sngar mis ma 'gom pa'i gtsang po'i gad phugs kyi bye ma blangs la/ khyi 'brug glang gi rus pa khams sa chu ma phog pa/ nas dkar/ g.yu/ dung / mu tig rnams zhib par btags nas bsres la snam dkar gyi khugs mar blugs pa'i thun bya zhing bdag bskyed gong bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'od 'phros 'gro la gnod byed pa'i/ /nag cing gsher ba sa bdag klu/ /gnyan bdud rlon btswa' ci mchis kun/ /skad cig nyid la 'joms nus par/ /sogs gong bzhin brjod/ rtsa gsum sngags la bsham bu ni/ kaṃ kaṃ/ king king / kung kung / btswa'i mchu chings/

padma ra tsa'i mchu chog ces btags grangs mang bzlas pa'i phus btab la bsngo smon shis brjod byas te zhing khar/ khyi/ 'brug glang / lug lo pa/ zhwa gos nag po rdor dkar can rnams/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i spyan ras gzigs su bskyed la/ g.yon gyi snam dkar gyi khug mar gong gi skam thun bzung / g.yas kyis sa bon 'debs pa bzhin zhing gi mgo nas zhing gzhug gi bar gtor la/ sngags bzla shes pa'am rang gis skad chen pos bzlas la/ dmigs pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi g.yas kyi shel 'phreng las 'od dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas btswa' thams cad bcom par bsam zhing bsrung 'khor bsngo smon sogs gong bzhin bya ba ste/ rlon btswa' bsrung ba'o// ༈ /gsum pa btswa' khra bo byung na/ gzhung nas gsungs pa'i rdzas/ rten 'brel/ ting 'dzin/ sngags rim 'gro rjes gcod/ drug ka bya dgos pas/ de ltar gsungs pa'i sa gcod rnams bkrugs te/ thog mar rim 'gro ni/ don yod zhags pa/ sman bla/ gzi brjid rgyal mo/ rnam 'joms/ snang brgyad/ sdong brgyan/ klu'i gzungs nas 'byung ba'i cho ga rnams las ci 'grub bya zhing / cha gsum gtor ma dang / chab klu ni nges par dgos sam snyam/ de nas gong du bshad pa'i skam rlon bsrung ba'i rdzas rnams dang / khams sa dang bye ma bsres pa/ yungs dkar/ yang gtsang 'gram gyi bye ma/ mchod rten mang po'i sa/ dge 'dun mang pos phyag bsil pa'i sa/ dngul thal lam/ dngul phye ste 'di rnams lhan cig bsres nas snod gang yang rung bar bshams la/ gong bzhin bsgom bzlas byas te/ skam rlon srung ba'i rdzas rnams la/ so so'i sngags dang / khams sa phye ma bsres pa la/ oṃ na ga buṃ sa shig sogs bsham bur btags pa/ yungs dkar la kaṃ kaṃ sogs bsham bur btags pa grangs ci rigs dang / gtsang 'gram bye ma mchod rten gyi sa sogs lhan cig bsres pa de la/ oṃ na ga buṃ sa sogs bsham bur btags pa lnga khri bzlas nas btab/

rdzas thams cad badzra gu ru dang phur pa sogs rang nyid gang la yi dam du bya ba de la/ sme rtsegs kyi sngags dang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ pri thi wi bhya:swāhā/ zhes pa'i lha mo bstan ma'i snying po dang / ye dharma rnams kyang so so nas ci 'grub re bzlas la phus btab ste gong bzhin grub/ shog bu la mi gzugs gcer bu kha shas bris pa'i mdog ser po'i snying khar ra/ dmar po'i snying khar tsa/ sngon po'i snying khar na/ ser po'i snying khar bha/ smug po dang nag po'i snying khar ma bris pa ste 'di dag la grangs med pas gang mang bris kyang chog shog bu'am gro ga la rtsa gsum sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ sa du rbad swāhā/ bdud tram ya rbad: tri mā ra ya kha hril dzaḥdzaḥrbad: zhing 'di zhes bya ba la rakṣa rakṣaḥ zhes bris la ye dhar gyis sngags pa'i me tog gtor te 'jag dkar sbom po'i rtse la dkris pa du ma dang / ras gzhi la ra'i g.yang gzhi bris par lo'i btswa' dang / btsag bsres pa'i rgya gram dang thig le mang po byas pa gsum mam lnga/ shing rtser bskyon pa dang / lcags btswas khyer ba dum tsam cig rdo la zhing gi btswa' bkus pa gcig ste de gnyis la ra tshil gyis byug ra lpags kyis bstum pa brgya/ sātstsha dkar po rab gnas can brgya rnams grabs byas la/ de nas zla ba gang yang rung ba'i gza' tshes shis pa zhig la bya ba'i zhing der song ste/ thog mar sde brgyad cha snyoms/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ chab klu/ mdo thig snang brgyad/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ sdong brgyan rnams klags la/ mi zhwa gos dmar po rdor dkar can gyi lag tu mda' dar dmar po dang / snam ras dmar po g.yas g.yon gang ba re bzung zhing skad chen pos yul 'di zhes bya ba'i zhing 'di zhes bya ba la/ btswa' ser rgyal po'i kha rlangs byung ngo / /btswa' dmar btsan dang ma mo'i༞ /btswa' nag sa bdag klu gnyan bdud kyi༞

/btswa' khra bo sde brgyad kyi kha rlangs byung ngo / /zer zhing zhing gi mtha' 'khor bar rgyugs la mda' dar snam ras rnams g.yab cing 'khor ba dang / dong khru gang pa'i nang du mda' dar snam ras rnams sbas/ zhwa gos lh+wam dmar rnams phud de skya bo sogs gang bder bsgyur/ de nas zhing dkyil dang mtha' skor sna tshogs su mi zhwa gos lh+wam nag gyon pa kha shas dang zhwa gos lh+wam skya gyon pa kha shas bcas rdor dkar la gnas pas thog mar/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /zhes sogs shis pa gang shes 'don/ de nas gong du bris pa'i lha 'dre'i liṅga ming yig rnams lag mthil g.yon par gan brgyal du bsgyel/ g.yas pa de'i steng du thal mo drag tu bsdeb cing / btswa' gtong ba'i lha 'dre thams cad rang rang gi gnas su song cigaḥ byer cigaḥ bros cigaḥ zhes dang / ku drag tu bton la phyogs thams cad zing zhing rgyugs tshar ba dang zhing gi mtha' skor du shing sna'i dud pa me lce med pa btang / gong du 'jag mar dkris pa'i sngags rnams zhing gi mtha' dbus med pa gang khyab btsugs/ grab skyer gyi phyi rol mtshams brgyad du tho dkar po mi gzugs tsam mgo nag por yod pa btab/ de nas skam btswa' bsrung ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rlon thun gyis brabs tshar ba dang gtsang 'gram mchod rten gyi sa sogs lhan cig bsres pa'i skam thun de yang / rlon thun thor mi rnams kyis 'thor tshul rlon thun bzhin 'thor zhing / rlon thun gyi sngags dang gong du bshad pa'i bla ma yi dam sogs kyi sngags gang shes bzla/ de nas khye'u gtsang mas/ khrus sna klu sman dang chu sbyar ba/ chab gtor gyi chu rnams khyer la 'thor tshul sngags bcas rlon thun bzhin la/ yang rlon btswa' bsrung ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi skam thun gtor tshar ba dang / mi de rnams kyis bye ma dang khams sa bsres pa skam thun ltar 'thor zhing / rlon thun gyi sngags dang bla ma yi dam sogs kyi sngags bzla/

yungs dkar skam thun ltar 'thor zhing / skam thun gyi sngags dang bla ma yi dam sogs gyi sngags bzla/ de nas gong gi g.yang gzhi mi rnams kyi zhing gi mtha' skor du 'phyar nas/ bso dang ki la sogs pa ca co sna tshogs 'don pas skor/ rang nyid kyi skad chen pos yul 'di zhes bya ba'i/ zhing 'di rnams la gnod pa'i btswa' thams cad bstan 'gror gnod pa'i gdug pa can gang du gnas pa'i yul du song nas da med do/ /ra'i g.yang gzhi 'dre srin tshogs pa'i ru dar gyi logs la btswa' thams cad thim 'dug go /btswa' thams cad ra'i g.yang gzhi'i logs la thim cig zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ ra'i g.yang gzhi rnams mi rnams kyis khyer te yul de'i 'thung chu zhing chu min nges zhig la dag par bkrus/ bsrung 'khor gong bzhin bsgom la/ phyi rol gyi tho rnams la dmigs la sbyangs 'khrus spyi 'gre ltar byas te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ tho rnams mi dmigs stong nyid las/ /padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan/ /de las 'phro 'du yongs gyur las/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang / /zhal gcig mche gtsigs dmar zlum spyan/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra 'bar/ /sbom thung sha rgyas rags shing grims/ /phyag g.yas rgya gram thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa des mtshan dril kur bstan/ /rin chen sbrul dang stag sham can/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang me 'bar dbus/ /rab brjid bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du/ /rdo rje gsum dngos oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nyer gcig sogs grangs mang brjod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /dbang bskur don yod grub pas mtshan/ /mchod yon me tog spos mar me/ /dri dang zhal zas rol mo sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes par gyur/

/'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ne swāhā/ lan gsum gyis spyan dbye/ thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig las/ /rang sngags kyis bskor 'od zer gyis/ /lo dgra gnod pa ma lus pa/ /bsrung zhing skyobs pa'i las mdzad gyur/ /zhes dang / gong du bshad pa'i a mṛ ta'i sngags 'phreng 'khor sogs bzlas la/ ye dharmas brtan bzhugs rab gnas sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ bye brag tu yang khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba tho 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas lo dgra thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes dang / dril bu gsil me tog gi char ye dhar lan gsum sogs byas mthar bkra shis ci shes brjod la/ nam mkha'i khams nas rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dpag tu med par byon nas lo tog la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes dang / me tog gtor la/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs/ lhas kyang dus su char sogs/ mkha' la glog 'phreng sogs/ de rnams rtswa dang sogs/ yul phyogs kun tu char chu sogs/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni sogs/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs gang shes brjod la me tog gi char dbab/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /sogs gong bzhin brjod la/ gong du mda' dar dmar po snam ras dmar po sbas pa de bton/ zhing gi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du dong khru gang pa brkos te/ gong du bshad pa'i rdzas lcags btswa' rdo btswa' tshil byugs lcags bstum ma rnams bcug la sa rdos bkab ste/ de'i steng du tho che chung ci rigs brtan par rtsigs pa'i nang / sātstsha rab gnas can dkar po de bzhugs la yedhar bzlas pa'i me tog gtor te bkra shis kyi tshig brjod do/ /ston ka rtsas ma tshar ba dang zhing khar song la spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed byas te sngags bzla mi dgos par/

mchod yon me tog nas phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar brjod la khu tshur rgyab sbyar mtheb srin gyi se gol dang badzra muḥ tho bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam chig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod la bsdus/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs bya'o// //ces dgongs 'dus nas gsungs pa'i btswa' bsrung rdo rje pha lam gyi gsal byed 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma dgongs 'dus las btswa' bsrung rdo rje pha lam gyi gsal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
